procs.name: Umbral Glaive
procs.tooltip:
|cFF66DDFFLevel 30 Passive|r
Ranged attacks now have a $h% chance to transform |cffffffffHex of Malice|r into |cffffffffUmbral Glaive|r for $504588d.@s:501134:0@

procs.proc_spell_source: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:157-158 (Proc case UmbralTalent: buff(UmbralReady) is Cast(owner, owner, 504588)); 504588 Umbral Glaive, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, the tooltip token $504588d
procs.handler: aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event (spell_script_names row of 681242, rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:174-175): Check case UmbralTalent (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:91-96) accepts an outgoing damage hit that is not Umbral Glaive 501134 itself and whose proc type mask holds PROC_FLAG_DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK or PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS, and rolls roll_chance_f(ProcChance 10 + player->GetRatingBonusValue(CR_CRIT_RANGED)) once; the engine roll is neutralised (spell_proc Chance 100 since rev_20261003_10_coa_script_rolled_proc_chance.sql, which fixed the P x P double roll of #4275 that made 10% into 1%), so the script roll is the only one. The reference character has no ranged critical strike rating (the class file ratings hold the three hit ratings only), so the chance is the 10% of the DBC. Trigger: Reclamation 806288 (DmgClass 3 ranged, SpellFamilyFlags[1] bit 4, RangeIndex 113, 8% of the base mana, CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms, StartRecoveryTime 1500, needs the bow 2000265 the harness equips through armed_for) at the dummy 15 yd away (a ranged cast at the melee default distance is refused as TOO_CLOSE, Spell.cpp:7352-7357; RangeIndex 113 is 0 to 30 yd; the missile of Speed 35 lands about 430 ms after the 1800 ms cast, inside the 2300 ms attempt spacing; the reference character carries ranged_hit_rating 10000). Each landed Reclamation is one trial: it grants a Spirit but Umbral Glaive does not read Spirit. The baseline phase (the passive unknown) casts the trigger and must read no ready buff cast. Residual failure probability (estimate, normal approximation, the tool states its own figure in the verdict row): the band is 2 points (the larger of 5% of 10 and 2); residual_target 0.001 judges the pooled Wilson interval at confidence 0.9995 (z 3.48), whose half-width at 16470 attempts (one trial each, 90 parts of 183) is 0.81 points, so band + 2 x half-width = 3.63 points, under min_detectable 4; a true rate of a server 4 points off (14% or 6%) is rejected with probability above 0.99999, and a correct 10% server is falsely alerted with probability at most 0.001 per pair. The attempts are 2300 ms of game time each, 10.5 h per run, 90 parts of about 7 game minutes; accelerated, the Witch Hunter proofs of this size took minutes of wall time.

Shadow Puppets 500015: instant, GCD 1500, 15% base mana, RecoveryTime 18000 reset before each cast, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, EffectAmplitude 750 with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, so 5 PuppetHit events per cast. internal_cooldown_ms 3250 is the attempt spacing, not a spell_proc cooldown (the row's Cooldown is 0): the attempts are 3750 ms apart so a cast's 3000 ms aura (extra initial tick plus four ticks of 750 ms) ends before the next cast refreshes it and every cast gives 5 trials.

behaviours.name: Spirit Out Of The Bottle (Spirit gained)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:320-321 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered cast): if (IsBottle(info) && player->HasAura(OutOfBottle)) GainSpirit(player). Spirit in a Bottle 801696 has SpellFamilyFlags[2] bit 1 (IsBottle, Completion.h:380). GainSpirit (Completion.cpp:137-150) casts Spirit 561136 once on the caster. Control (before phase): 801696 cast without 301175 known reads 0 stacks of 561136 (no other path grants Spirit to a Bottle cast); after: exactly 1, so a doubled grant also alerts. 301175's own Effect[0] is aura 42 triggering 561136; reading exactly 1 also proves that native path does not add a second Spirit.

behaviours.name: Mirage (5 Spirits)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:345-346 (OnSpellCast): if (id == Mirage) GainSpirit(player, 5). Mirage's native Effect[1] (SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 561136) is zeroed at load (Completion.cpp:406-407), so the script is the only Spirit source. Control: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0 stacks of 561136; after: one Mirage cast reads 5 (the aura's stack cap, so the entry cannot see an extra grant; it does catch a missing or short one).

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (5 clones)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:184-188 (Summon): spell == Marionette selects NpcMarionette 300661 and count = 5, one SummonCreature per clone owned by the player; called from AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:239-240 when the Marionette aura 704497 applies. Marionette's native Effect[1] summon (MiscValue 300661) and Effect[2] are zeroed (Completion.cpp:418-422), so the script is the only source. Clones last 8500 ms (Summons.cpp:193-194), read at 3000 ms. Control: before phase casts nothing and reads 0 owned creatures of entry 300661; after: 5.

behaviours.name: Mojo High (additional Mimic Ward)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:189-190 (Summon): if (spell == Mimic) count = max(1, Effects[EFFECT_2].CalcValue(player)); Mimic Ward 707162 Effect[2] (SUMMON, MiscValue 300659) has DieSides 0 and Completion.cpp:250-251 pins its BasePoints to 1, so CalcValue is 1 ward. Mojo High 706488 Effect[0] aura 107 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3, MiscValue 23, class mask 512 which Mimic Ward's SpellFamilyFlags[0] 8704 carries) has DieSides 1, so its modifier is +1 and Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers makes CalcValue 2. Both phases cast Mimic Ward at the caster, 706488 learned between them (control = before phase, 1 ward); a new cast despawns the earlier ward of the same slot (Summons.cpp:216-220), so the first phase's ward cannot inflate the count. Needs a first run to confirm the SPELLMOD reaches CalcValue(player); if the read is 1 the entry alerts and points at that path.

behaviours.name: A Price To Pay (Spirit Glaive cooldown reset)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:333-338 (OnSpellCast): else-if Family(info,0,536870912) (Spirit Eclipse 801607) { if (count == 5 && player->HasAura(PriceToPay)) { Reduce(player, Glaive, INT32_MAX); Cast(player, player, PriceReady); } }; Reduce (Completion.cpp:161-174) calls RemoveSpellCooldown on every known rank of Spirit Glaive 806289 (CategoryRecoveryTime 20000). count is the Spirit stacks at cast start: Mirage 501136 is the setup cast that makes 5 Spirits without set_aura. Each phase casts Glaive 806289, then Mirage, then Eclipse; 705948 learned between phases. Control: before phase leaves Glaive at about 20000 minus the setup waits (about 14000, tolerance 4500 covers cast times and the simulated clock; a reset reads 0, so the two arms never overlap); calibrate before_expected on the first run.

behaviours.name: Splash On Em (Loa's Brew reduces Mojo Beam cooldown)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:328-329 (OnSpellCast): if (Family(info, 1, 131072) && player->HasAura(SplashOnEm)) Reduce(player, Beam, 2000); Loa's Brew 801670 has SpellFamilyFlags[1] 131072; Reduce is ModifySpellCooldown(-2000) on each known rank of Mojo Beam 500950 (RecoveryTime 14000). Each phase casts Mojo Beam at the caster (starts its 14000 ms cooldown), then Loa's Brew, and reads the Beam cooldown 1000 ms later; 802219 learned between phases. Control: the before phase (no talent) reads the cooldown the Beam still has; the judge takes after minus before and requires -2000 within 100 (before_expected 6000 is the least before reading so no floor hides the cut, expected = 6000 - 2000). Same waits in both phases, so clock overhead cancels.

behaviours.name: Splash On Em (Mojo Beam recast after Loa's Brew)
behaviours.quote: reduces the cooldown of Mojo Beam by 2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:328-329 (OnSpellCast): Family(info, 1, 131072) (Loa's Brew 801670) with 802219 known calls Reduce(player, Beam, 2000), ModifySpellCooldown(-2000) on every known rank of Mojo Beam 500950 (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174); the hook runs when the 2000 ms Brew cast completes (cycle 1 read 10491 ms when it read too early). Mojo Beam RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 14000 ms, a channel, cast at the caster (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY). Each arm casts Mojo Beam, then Loa's Brew 2500 ms later (past the 1500 ms global cooldown; the Brew is cast in every arm and only 802219 differs), then attempts Mojo Beam at the stated cooldown plus or minus 500 ms counted from the Beam cast: without 802219 at 12500 ms it is refused (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, 1500 ms left, the control), with it learned it goes through (0), and at 11500 ms with it it is refused again, so the cut is no larger than 2 sec. The Brew completes at 4500 ms, long before every attempt. This consumes the cooldown: the recast is accepted, which a cooldown_ms read does not show. Regeneration is off and cast_power sets the mana only before the Beam casts, while the Beam channel drains mana at a rising rate every 500 ms (AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:191-198); at cast_power 1000 the Brew 2500 ms later was refused with SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER in every arm (prove-c2s, lead-802219-recast.md), so cast_power is 2000 (below the 2567 maximum mana), leaving about 1175 mana for the Brew's 33% of about 1490 base mana. A Brew refused for mana would read as a missing cut.

behaviours.name: Mirage (copy left behind)
behaviours.quote: leaving a copy of yourself behind
behaviours.observe_source: Mirage 501136 Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON (EffectMiscValue 840000, TARGET_DEST_CASTER, DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms) is not zeroed by the contract (Completion.cpp:406-407 zeroes Effect[1] only). The summon spell script (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:570-596) calls Summon(player, 501136, ...), which takes entry 840000 from the SUMMON effect (Summons.cpp:177-183), count 1, owner = the caster; the creature runs away from the caster (Summons.cpp:286-289, RunAwayFrom). Control: the uncast before phase reads 0 owned creatures of entry 840000; after one real Mirage cast, 2000 ms later, exactly 1.

behaviours.name: Mirage (ended by direct damage)
behaviours.quote: Direct damage or healing done will end this effect.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:277-278 (OnSpellHitResult): (damage || healing) && id != Spirit && !Family(info, 0, 8) && !spell->IsTriggered() removes Mirage 501136 from the caster. Mirage is a real setup cast (M-9; instant, CastingTimeIndex 1, 29% mana, cooldown 180000 reset by the scenario) made at the caster in both phases, followed by a 1600 ms wait past the 1500 ms global cooldown (StartRecoveryTime 1500, category 133, shared with the Glaive), so the Glaive that follows is accepted. cast_power 1000 sets the mana before the setup cast (Mirage 29% plus Glaive 10% of about 1490 base mana). Control (before phase, cast_in_before false): Mirage cast, no damage, the aura still reads 1 stack 1600 ms later. After: the same Mirage, then one real Spirit Glaive 806289 at the dummy (Shadow direct damage, 2000 ms cast, cooldown 20000 reset by the scenario, spell hit rating 10000), read 3000 ms after the Glaive cast starts, about 1000 ms after the hit lands: 0.

behaviours.name: Mirage (ended by direct healing)
behaviours.quote: Direct damage or healing done will end this effect.
behaviours.observe_source: Same hook as damage_ends (Abilities.cpp:277-278, the healing argument). Mirage is a real setup cast at the caster in both phases (M-9) with a 1600 ms wait past the 1500 ms global cooldown. cast_power 1000 sets the mana before it (Mirage 29% plus Loa's Brew 33% of about 1490 base mana is 924). Loa's Brew 801670 (2000 ms cast, CastingTimeIndex 5, SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY) is cast at the caster, held at 50% health so the heal is effective; read 3000 ms after the cast starts, 1000 ms after the heal lands. Control: the before phase makes the Mirage cast and no heal, and reads Mirage still on (1); after: 0. Calibrate on the first run: if the hook's healing argument is the effective heal only and the health fixture does not take, the read stays 1.

behaviours.name: Mirage (the invisible caster sees only invisible targets)
behaviours.quote: you can only see other invisible targets
behaviours.observe_source: The tooltip governs (G-1): an invisible caster sees only invisible targets and those who can see invisible. The reference dummy (creature 36) is visible and detects nothing invisible. Unit::CanSeeOrDetect(dummy) of the caster is read: before the cast (control) 1, after one real Mirage cast 0. No Witch Doctor code restricts the caster's sight: grep of AscensionWitchDoctor*.cpp finds Mirage only at Abilities.cpp:277-278, 345-352 and Auras.cpp:170, 335, 404 (stat, threat, speed, summon), and Mirage's only aura is Effect[0] 18 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY, which in stock rules does not hide the world from its holder. A read of 1 after the cast is therefore a candidate defect for the lead, not a test fault. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (clones apply a stack)
behaviours.quote: applying a stack of Soul Marionette
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:307-308 starts each of the 5 clones (entry 300661) with a 2000 ms timer; at the tick Summons.cpp:559-562 (++_marionetteTicks <= 4, player has Marionette) casts the stack aura 807057 on the caster, one stack per clone per tick, max 20 stacks (StackAmount 20). The first tick of all 5 clones falls at about 2000 ms, the second at about 4000 ms, so 3000 ms after the cast the caster holds exactly 5 stacks. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0 stacks of 807057.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette stack (haste per stack)
behaviours.quote: Increases your haste by 1% per stack.
behaviours.observe_source: Completion.cpp:423-428 turns Effect[0] of 807057 into SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS with BasePoints 0 and DieSides 1 (1% per stack); SpellAuraEffects.cpp:659 multiplies the amount by the stack amount, so the 5 stacks of the stacks entry read an amount of 5 (5% haste). Control: the uncast before phase reads 0 (no aura). The amount is the aura effect's own value, the haste actually applied to the caster follows from it. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Veil of Darkness (veil on the target for 15 sec)
behaviours.quote: increasing the damage you deal to them by $s1% for $d.
behaviours.observe_source: Cause of the cycle 1 flake (baseline 20261114-235616 aura present, 20261115-011935 absent, same build and scenario, both cast_failure 0 and cooldown 89982): Veil 802100 is a Shadow aura-only spell. SpellMgr.cpp:3929 sets SPELL_ATTR0_CU_BINARY_SPELL on it (Effect[0] aura 271 with a non-zero value), and the override at SpellMgr.cpp:4063-4099 that clears the flag for spells whose periodic trigger spell is not binary does not fire, because the contract has already turned Effect[1] into a periodic dummy with TriggerSpell 0 (Completion.cpp:284-285, run in LoadSpellInfoCorrections, World.cpp:415, before LoadSpellInfoCustomAttributes, World.cpp:429). A binary spell adds Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance to the full-resist roll (Unit.cpp:4092-4098): the level 60 dummy's linear monster resistance, 60 x CoA.MonsterResistance.PerLevel 1.0 / PerPercent 5.0 = 12%, a SPELL_MISS_RESIST that leaves cast_failure 0 and starts the cooldown. The spell hit roll cannot be the cause: Unit.cpp:4055-4062 caps the hit chance at 100% and the class file's spell_hit_rating 10000 reaches it. The resist is derived by reading the code, not observed: the value scenarios keep no combat log. Fixture: caster aura 823764 (beeg spellpen, SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -9999 on all magic schools, the fixture of the hit and Crypt Plague entries) sets the dummy's effective resistance to 0 (Unit.cpp:2615-2622, 2625-2626), so the resist chance is 0. 823764 is a phase aura of both phases, not the cause. Control: the uncast before phase reads the aura absent. After one real cast: held at 14700 ms, gone at 15300 ms, inside the G-19 band 14250 to 15750 ms around $d = 15000 ms (SpellDuration 8) in game time.

behaviours.name: Sen'jin's Wisdom (Mirage lasts twice as long)
behaviours.observe_source: Native effect, no script: 504774 Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), +20000 ms (BasePoints 19999 + DieSides 1), class mask [2] 1073741824 = Mirage's SpellFamilyFlags[2] 1073741824; Mirage DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms, so a doubling. Each phase casts Mirage at the caster and reads the aura's remaining duration 100 ms later; 504774 is learned between the phases (control: the before phase, about 19900 ms). Judged as the after reading over the before reading, 2 within 0.02 (about 39900 over 19900 = 2.005), so the clock overhead cancels. expire_ms 2000 puts the second Mirage cast past the 1500 ms global cooldown of the first (the Mirage cooldown itself is reset by the scenario); the first Mirage aura is still running and the recast refreshes it. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Residual Energy (Lesser Shadow Avatar when Shadow Avatar ends)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:417-418 (aura remove): Avatar 705943 removed by AURA_REMOVE_BY_EXPIRE with Residual 706543 known casts Lesser Shadow Avatar 706544 on the caster (DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms). Shadow Avatar DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms, so 15600 ms after the cast it has ended and the Lesser Avatar has been on for 600 ms. behaviours.name: Spirit Hunting (extra Spirit per Malefic Arrow, 15% per Spirit)
behaviours.quote: Each active Spirit gives you a 15% chance when you cast Malefic Arrow to generate an additional Spirit.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:313-314 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered cast): if (IsArrow(info) && player->HasAura(SpiritHunting) && roll_chance_i(count * 15)) GainSpirit(player); count is the 561136 stack count snapshotted in OnSpellBeforeEffects (Abilities.cpp:101), which Spell.cpp:4044 calls before OnSpellCast (Spell.cpp:4191). GainSpirit (Completion.cpp:137-150) casts 561136 once, also at the 5-stack cap, so spell_cast_count of 561136 counts every extra Spirit; set_aura uses AddAura and casts nothing. Malefic Arrow 801674: IsArrow (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x80008000, Completion.h:372-375), not Family(1,4), so it grants no Spirit of its own; castable with ArrowTalent 707854 known (Abilities.cpp:83), needs the bow (EquippedItemSubClassMask 262156), instant (CastTime -1000000), GCD 1500, 8000 ms cooldown reset each cast, 5% base mana. cast_power 1000 is unverified for the bow: the 2567 maximum mana read in compare-c1 was taken with the reference weapon 72038, not the bow, and a set_power above the maximum errors the scenario rather than misjudging it. 707504 is passive with ProcFlags 0, so its native aura 42 (trigger 561136) never fires. Tooltip literal 15% per Spirit. Judged on each arm total (mentor M-1, ADR 0662 provisional), each arm sized flip-proof (mentor M-14/M-14a): n >= p(1-p)((2.576 + 3.719)/band)^2, the Wilson 99% interval of a true total chance leaving its band at most 1e-4 per edge; 5 Spirits 75% (band 3.75 points) needs 5284 casts, 4 Spirits 60% (band 3 points) needs 10568, the two cheapest stack counts; 9 parts of 588 and 1175 (5292 and 10575 per run), about 47.6 game minutes each, 428.7 per run (Witch Doctor ADR 0001).

behaviours.name: Loa Spirits (Reclamation casts an additional time, 5% per Spirit)
behaviours.quote: For each active Spirit on you, you have a $561361s1% chance for your Reclamation to cast an additional time.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:305-309 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered cast): Family(info,1,4) (Reclamation 806288, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 268435460) -> GainSpirit(player), then if (player->HasAura(LoaEcho) && target && roll_chance_i(count * 5)) Cast(player, target, id); the recast is triggered, so OnSpellCast returns before a second GainSpirit and no recast rolls again. spell_cast_count counts every cast of 806288, triggered or not, so events are the 806288 casts less one per trial, and trials are the 561136 casts (one per player Reclamation). Tooltip $561361s1: 561361 EffectBasePoints[0] 4 + DieSides 1 = 5% per Spirit. 705843 is passive with ProcFlags 0, so its native aura 42 (trigger 707422, which re-triggers 806288, ProcChance 1) does not fire; if it came alive, the 0-stack control would catch it with probability 1 - 0.99^n, 99.9992% for the 1170 control casts of one run (13 parts of 90). Reclamation: cast 1800 ms + 500 ranged, GCD 1500, no cooldown, 8% base mana, bow; cast_power 1000 is unverified for the bow (the 2567 maximum mana of compare-c1 was read with the reference weapon 72038, not the bow). Judged on each arm total (mentor M-1, ADR 0662 provisional), each arm sized flip-proof (mentor M-14/M-14a): n >= p(1-p)((t + 3.719)/band)^2 with the between-part t quantile 3.055 (12 df), the 99% interval of a true total chance leaving its band at most 1e-4 per edge; 1 Spirit 5% needs 5449 casts and 2 Spirits 10% need 10324 (band 2 points each), the two cheapest stack counts; 13 parts of 420 and 795 (5460 and 10335 per run), about 54.8 game minutes each, 712.3 per run (Witch Doctor ADR 0001). Both arms also alert on a roll that counts the Spirit this Reclamation grants (10% and 15%).

behaviours.name: A Price To Pay (Spirit Glaive cooldown cleared on the client)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:333-338 (OnSpellCast): Spirit Eclipse 801607 (Family 0 536870912) cast with count == 5 Spirits and 705948 known calls Reduce(player, Glaive, INT32_MAX); AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174 sends it as Player::RemoveSpellCooldown(806289, true) (Player.cpp:3949-3955: erase the cooldown, then SendClearCooldown), so the client is told the Glaive may be cast again: one SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN (0x1DE, 478) whose first field is 806289, counted by server_packets with row 806289 (the harness registers the row from the step, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:2130-2135, ObserveExtensionPacket :1385-1389). Same real setup as the reset entry: Glaive (2000 ms cast), then Mirage 501136 (instant, 5 real Spirits through GainSpirit, Abilities.cpp:345-346; the trigger's own required Spirit aura is set before the setup casts, so Mirage's five stacks are the count of 5), 2000 ms apart, then Eclipse (count read at cast start, Abilities.cpp:101). The count is cumulative and every harness reset_cooldown of 806289 sends the same packet (RemoveSpellCooldown with update true), so each phase holds exactly one fixture clear before the Glaive cast: before phase (705948 unknown, the control) 1; after phase 1 + 1 fixture clear of the second phase + 1 from the talent = 3; without the talent it would read 2. This is the event the server sends when the cooldown is cleared, not a recast: the recast acceptance read (cost_gate resets, arms refused without and accepted with) is not expressible with real Spirits, because cost_gate re-sets 561136 to 1 stack right before an after cast of Eclipse (values.py:190-193, behaviours.py:3995-4000), so Eclipse would see 1 Spirit, not 5; it needs the keep_required_aura owner tool.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (Malefic Wrath cast held at 1715 ms under 15 stacks)
behaviours.quote: applying a stack of Soul Marionette.
behaviours.observe_source: The quote is the stack sentence of 704497; the ledger clause the labels attach to, Increases your haste by 1% per stack., is the 807038 text embedded in the 704497 tooltip (@s:807038:0@), which the quote check cannot match, and the stack it describes is what this entry exercises. Soul Marionette 704497 casts 5 clones (Summons.cpp:177-193, 5 x NpcMarionette 300661); each has a 2000 ms timer (Summons.cpp:307-308) and at each tick, up to 4 times, casts the stack aura 807057 on the caster (Summons.cpp:559-562), 5 stacks per tick, so the ticks at about 2000, 4000, 6000 and 8000 ms leave 5, 10, 15 and 20 stacks. 807057 is raw DBC Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (216), but Completion.cpp:423-428 rewrites Effect[0] to SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (base 0, die 1, 1% per stack) and zeroes Effect[1], so the effective haste effect is Effect[0] (the aura_amount of the haste entry reads 5 at 5 stacks), which Unit::ApplyCastTimePercentMod turns into UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED 1 / 1.15 at 15 stacks. Malefic Wrath 807037 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, DmgClass 1 magic, RangeIndex 4 = 0..30 yd, no cooldown, no category, 1500 ms global cooldown, 11% mana, not the Glaive's family flag) is the cast whose time is read: Unit::ModSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:13056-13068) multiplies a DmgClass 1 cast by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED. The Spirit Glaive is not used: Unit.cpp:13045-13047 divides its cast time by an Agility term. The after phase casts Marionette for real (setup_only_after, the entry's own spell) and starts the Wrath 6120 ms later, after the 6000 ms tick (stacks 15) and early enough that the cast, with 15% haste 2000 / 1.15 = 1739 ms, ends before the 8000 ms tick (20 stacks). Control (before phase): no Marionette, the same Wrath cast: 2000 ms. Read 1715 ms nominal, about 1725 to 1732 ms of game time after the cast starts (G-19: the larger of 5% and 2 points around 15%, 13..17%: 2000 / 1.17 = 1709 to 2000 / 1.13 = 1770 ms): casting in both phases (the held half, as Necromancer Scourge Disciple 531126 cast_held). The after reading's game time must lie in the band, else alert.

behaviours.name: Soul Marionette (Malefic Wrath cast done at 1752 ms under 15 stacks)
behaviours.quote: applying a stack of Soul Marionette.
behaviours.observe_source: As the haste_cast_held entry: the read at 1752 ms nominal, about 1762 to 1769 ms of game time after the Malefic Wrath cast starts, falls inside the G-19 band 1709..1770 ms. Without Marionette the 2000 ms cast is still running (casting 1, the control); with 15 stacks (15% haste, 1739 ms, ending on the first 25 ms server step at or after 1739 ms) the cast is done (casting 0). Together with haste_cast_held the cast with haste ends in (1715, 1770] ms of game time, 13 to 17 percent faster than 2000 ms.

behaviours.name: Mirage (the invisible caster no longer has the visible dummy at its client)
behaviours.quote: you can only see other invisible targets
behaviours.observe_source: The tooltip governs (G-1): an invisible caster sees only invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Mirage's Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY (type 0, general); AuraEffect::HandleModInvisibility (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1912) ends with Unit::UpdateObjectVisibility(forced true, fromUpdate true), which for a Player runs Unit::UpdateObjectVisibility and UpdateVisibilityForPlayer at once (PlayerUpdates.cpp:1735-1752): the caster's own visible set is rebuilt with CanSeeOrDetect(target, false, true) for every object in range, and WorldObject::CanDetectInvisibilityOf (Object.cpp:2001-2062) refuses a seer that is invisible to a target that cannot detect invisibility (the dummy, creature 36, detects none), so the dummy leaves the caster's client-visible set. nearby_creature_at_client reads Player::HaveAtClient for the nearest living creature 36 (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:4635-4640): the event the server applied to the client, not the CanSeeOrDetect predicate the sight entry reads. Control (before phase, cast_in_before false): the dummy (creature 36, spawned by the generator because the entry sets select_dummy, selected and settled 5000 ms) is at the client (1); after one real Mirage and 1000 ms the read is 0. A read of 1 after the cast would contradict the tooltip: a candidate defect lead (M-13), not a test fault. The Templar detection client entry steps the caster aside and back before each read because the dummy's own aura change runs no visibility update; here the caster's own aura change does (the forced update above), so no step is made. Calibrate the before read on the first run: a before reading of 0 means the dummy was never in the client set.

behaviours.name: Krag'wa's Blessing (Amphibimorph is instant cast)
behaviours.quote: Your Amphibimorph is now instant cast.
behaviours.observe_source: 807855 Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 10 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, -101 on the class mask 2147483648 of Amphibimorph 500952 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2147483648): Unit::ModSpellCastTime applies the SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME modifier to the cast time, which falls to 0, so Amphibimorph casts at once. Amphibimorph (CastingTimeIndex 4 = 1000 ms, DmgClass 1, cooldown 120000 reset by the scenario, range 0..30 yd, 18% mana) is a real cast at the dummy in both phases. Control (before phase, 807855 unknown): the 1000 ms cast is still running 300 ms after it starts (casting 1). After 807855 is learned: the cast was instant, so nothing is being cast 300 ms later (casting 0). expire_ms 2500 lets the control cast finish before the second phase.

behaviours.name: Splash On 'Em (Mojo Beam heals cut the Potion Toss cooldown)
behaviours.quote: Effective healing done by Mojo Beam now reduces the cooldown of Potion Toss and Splash Potion by 1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:129-152 (Mojo Beam 500950 Heal): each heal with an effective amount and 802219 known calls Reduce(player, Potion 801661, 1000) and Reduce(player, Splash 802710, 1000), ModifySpellCooldown(-1000) on every known rank (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174). Gated: 801661 (CategoryRecoveryTime 15000, RecoveryTime 0, server DBC set), castable once Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is cast for real (Abilities.cpp:74-75 refuses a potion without an ingredient; the 801702 CasterAuraSpell is also set by required_aura_steps, a precondition fixture). Mojo Beam: a channel (DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms) at the caster, one heal every 500 ms (EffectAmplitude[0]), no other ally so no branch; cancelled by cancel_aura after 3000 ms (about six heals), so the cut stops before the attempts and the per-heal bracket is (15000 - elapsed) / heals. Caster health set to 1% of the 10000 fixture maximum before the Beam (precondition fixture) so every heal is effective; the verdict checks no overheal. Expected recast about 15000 - 6 x 1000 = 9000 ms after the first cast (10000 with five heals); attempts every 100 ms from 6500 to 12000 ms, after the Beam's 1500 ms global cooldown. Control without 802219: every attempt refused with 67 (not ready; the plain cooldown ends at 15000). Ineffective arm, 802219 kept: the caster at full health (10000 of the 10000 fixture maximum), so every Beam heal is overhealing (Brewing.cpp:148-152 cuts only for an effective amount) and the verdict requires 0 effective healing; attempts every 500 ms from 6500 to 12000 ms must all read 67, so a cut on every heal (recast near 9000 ms) alerts. Beam mana: ManaCostPercentage 15 plus the rising per-tick drain (Brewing.cpp:191-198); cast_power 2000 before each cast, below the 2567 maximum.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (a brew is crafted)
behaviours.observe_source: Potion Toss 801661 ("Fill a potion from your Cauldron, and toss it at a friendly target"; instant, 18% mana, 15000 ms category cooldown reset by the scenario) has CasterAuraSpell 801702, the Has Ingredient Marker, which AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45 (SyncIngredients) casts only while an Ingredient is active and Cauldron Brewer 92085 is known. With Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 active, AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:236-243 (OnSpellHit, IsPotion) casts the Ingredient's brew on the target (PotionEffects, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:89-107): the Frog Bones potion 802971, an absorb shield (Frog Bones: "Potion: Grants target ally an absorption shield"). Both phases cast a real Frog Bones and then a real Potion Toss at the caster (1700 ms after, past the 1500 ms global cooldown; cast_power 1000 covers 5% plus 18% of about 1490 base mana). The before phase (92085 unknown, the control) has no marker, the cast is refused and 802971 reads 0; the after phase (92085 learned between) reads 802971 on the caster, 1. The outcome is the crafted brew. The harness sets the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 with set_aura before the setup cast in both phases, because it is the CasterAuraSpell of Potion Toss (a precondition fixture, the subject is the brew); the server removes it again on the Frog Bones cast when 92085 is unknown (SyncIngredients), which is what the control reads, and brew_marker proves that 92085 grants the marker without the fixture.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (an Ingredient prepares a brew)

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45 (SyncIngredients): with an Ingredient active and Cauldron Brewer 92085 known, the caster gets the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 (the CasterAuraSpell of Potion Toss 801661 and the gate of the Cauldron effects); without 92085 it is removed. Both phases brew Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 for real (instant, 5% mana, 500 ms category, 1500 ms GCD, 1700 ms settle): the control reads the marker absent (0) with an Ingredient and without 92085. 92085 is learned between the phases and Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is cast, which swaps the Ingredient (capacity 1) and runs SyncIngredients with the Brewer: the marker reads 1.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (one of each Ingredient)
behaviours.observe_source: Per-kind limit: Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 has StackAmount 3 in Spell.dbc, and the code sets StackAmount 1 on every Ingredient (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:384-388). The before phase casts Frog Bones once (the control, 1 stack); the after phase (92085 learned between) casts it twice more, three casts in all, and still reads 1 stack: a missing limit reads up to 3. The one_each_casts entry counts the casts, so a refused cast cannot read as a pass. Ingredient spells 801660 Jungle Shrooms, 801662 Fish Oil, 801663 Frog Bones and 801664 Bloodthistle: instant, 5% mana, 500 ms category cooldown, 1500 ms global cooldown; the scenario waits 1700 ms after each setup cast.

behaviours.name: Hexfire Mass (Serpent Ward once every 3 sec)
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once every 3 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: Hexfire Mass 807450 (server DBC set: aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 504777, ProcChance 30; spell_proc row ProcFlags 262144 DONE_PERIODIC, Cooldown 3000, rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:23, Chance set to 0 by rev_20260919_20_coa_proc_chance_parity.sql:16, so the DBC 30% applies, SpellMgr.cpp:2448-2449): AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:86-88 Check (periodic Hex damage) and :231-233 Proc, Summon(player, Serpent Ward 504777, target) of creature 50587 (504777 EffectMiscValue[0]). The 30% roll is forced by spell_mod_mutant SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS +1000% on 807450 (330%; Aura::CalcProcChance applies the caster's chance modifiers, SpellAuras.cpp:2354-2370; the ADR 0482 forcing fixture, never a rate proof), removed and read gone at the end. Triggers: Hex of Malice 801693 (rank 1, the only learned rank; instant, StartRecoveryTime 1500, EffectAmplitude[0] 3000 with no hasted period, DurationIndex 106 = 24000 ms, 20% base mana, so cast_power 2000; Effect[1] 2 is a direct hit at the cast, not periodic, so it never rolls) cast at four dummies 2020 ms apart (cycle 4 fix round; 2029 ms with the three 3 ms steps before each cast): dummy ticks 87 ms before dummy4, the dummy of the latest cast, and dummy3 and dummy2 about 975 and 1950 ms after it. 807450 is learned 935 ms after the round's last wait, 2964 ms after the dummy4 cast, after the dummy tick (2913 ms, stamped at most 25 ms late) and before the first dummy4 tick (3000 ms) and the window start reads; the 6150 ms window ends 9126 ms after that cast, before the first Hex ends (24000). Control: the ticks before the learn, no ward spawn on the timeline. With the stated gate every spawn is a dummy4 tick, 3000 ms apart, and the dummy tick 2913 ms after each is refused. lead_targets (dummy, dummy2, dummy3) read each dummy's first event and intervals since the dummy4 cast, and the timeline reads the first spawn and that cast: the dummy tick after the first spawn is its second event since the cast, so its offset (about 2900 ms) is a lower bound with one extrapolated interval, inside the band (2850 to 3150 ms) under the documented step model; the spawn interval (3000 ms) is the upper bound. A gate of 2700 ms answers that tick (spawns about 2900 ms apart, no lead bound near the band); 3300 ms leaves one spawn interval (unmeasured). Trigger gaps are read since the last Hex cast.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (Fish Oil: an ally inside 40 yd is buffed)
behaviours.quote: Cauldron: Increases the movement speed and swim speed of allies within
behaviours.reason: Ingredient: Fish Oil 801662 (instant, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, SpellFamilyName 19, 500 ms category) has Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL of 803269 every 1500 ms on the caster (Spell.dbc); 803269 (DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms) has two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID effects (aura 31 and aura 58, +10%, EffectRadiusIndex 23 = 40 yd), so the caster's own area-aura update puts 803269 on a grouped ally in range. The Ingredient is the active brew of 92085's 'Nearby allies are buffed based on the active brew' (the Brewer only gates the potion marker, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45, so no Brewer learn is needed for the area part). The Ingredient is cast for real at the caster, the ally is grouped (kind aura_presence) and read 4500 ms after the cast. Inside arm: the ally stands 35 yd away and must gain the aura (it reads 0 before the cast). Control arm: the ally stands 45 yd away, beyond the 40 yd radius, and must stay without it while the caster carries it (the 'caster' expectation). Player report #11066 (the cosmetic cauldron on the back) is a visual and is outside this clause. Scope of the proof: these entries do not learn the Brewer 92085 (aura_presence learns only the Ingredient it casts, behaviours.py:2349, and has no learn field), and no Brewer gate sits on the area fields, so they prove the Ingredient's own Cauldron area aura (803269 / 803697) and would also pass without 92085; the radius control arm is what they show. A learn field on aura_presence is tool note T6.

behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (curses up to 2 nearby enemies besides the target)
behaviours.quote: curses an enemy and up to 2 nearby enemies
behaviours.radius_reason: the tooltip gives no radius for 'nearby'; the extra dummies stand within 8 yd of the primary, inside the 10 yd the script searches (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:116-128), and the far dummy 5 yd beyond that
behaviours.observe_source: Umbral Glaive 501134 (instant, 9% mana, DmgClass ranged, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_LEECH on the target; Effect[1] zeroed at load, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:447-453): AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:116-128 (OnSpellBeforeEffects) adds the first two valid attackable enemies in line of sight within 10 yd of the target to Effect[0] (MaxAffectedTargets 3). The cast is gated by the ready buff 504588 (OnSpellCheckCast), which the scenario sets before the cast (named precondition fixture: the buff is the product of a ranged-hit roll, proven by the ready entry; a real proc would force the roll in this scenario). One cast at the primary dummy 3 yd out, four more dummies inside 8 yd of it (two more than the stated 2) and one beyond: the aura 501134 of the caster is read on every dummy 500 ms after the cast; the primary and exactly two of the four extra dummies carry it (3 in all, count_primary) and the far one does not. Player report #1506 does not name this part.

behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (scales with modifiers to Hex of Malice: Prolonged Malice doubles its duration)
behaviours.quote: Scales with modifiers to Hex of Malice.
behaviours.observe_source: Prolonged Malice 704505 (passive, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_DURATION +6000 ms, EffectBasePoints 5999 + DieSides 1) is a native modifier of the Hex of Malice family (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 33554432); AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:447-450 gives Umbral Glaive 501134 that family flag, so the modifier reaches it. Each phase sets the ready buff 504588 (named precondition fixture) and casts Umbral Glaive (instant, Speed 30, the dummy 3 yd out: the projectile lands about 100 ms after the cast) at the dummy, then reads the remaining duration of 501134 500 ms after the cast, 400 ms after the aura has landed; 704505 is learned between the phases (control: the before phase, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms, about 5500 left). With it the duration is 6000 + 6000 = 12000 (about 11500 left). Judged as the gain, after minus before, which does not depend on the elapsed time: 6000 within 300 (the G-19 band of 5% of 6000 ms); the before reading must reach 5000 so a missing aura (0) cannot pass. A missing modifier gains 0. Readback entry (M-11): it reports data conformant, not behaviour.

behaviours.name: Mojo Beam (Potion Toss costs 20% more while channeling)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:113-127 (aura_ascension_witch_doctor_beam::Apply) casts Mojo Beam 573288 on the caster at the apply of the Beam aura and gives it the Beam's remaining duration; Completion.cpp:347-354 gives 573288 Effect[0] the class mask (0, 2048, 536870913) that Potion Toss 801661 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 526336), Splash Potion 802710 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 536870912) and Spirit in a Bottle 801696 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 1) carry: Effect[0] aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% ($573288s1), Effect[1] SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME -10001; Unit.cpp:5096-5121 (CanCastDuringChannel) lets the three be cast during a Mojo Beam channel (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 4194304) and Unit::ModSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:13040-13043) sets their cast time to 0. Mojo Beam 501117: CastingTimeIndex 1 (instant), RecoveryTime 14000 reset by the scenario, GCD 1500, ManaCostPercentage 15 (about 224 of about 1490 base mana), DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms channel). cast_power 2000 is set before the cast (below the 2567 maximum); the caster is the target, so no dummy stands in the scenario. The read is taken 1000 ms after the cast, two heals into the channel (the cost drain ends it near 5500 ms, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:186-196, well after the read). Control: the before phase casts nothing, with the channel absent. before_expected 100 is only the floor of the before reading (ManaCostPercentage x about 1490 base mana is at least 223 for every spell here), so a zero cost cannot hide the ratio. Potion Toss 801661 costs 18% of the base mana; spell_power_cost reads SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost for the caster, which applies the SPELLMOD_COST modifiers of the auras on it, so the ratio of the cost during the channel to the uncast cost is 1.20, judged inside the G-19 band (the larger of 5% and 2 points of +20% is 2 points). Same subject as the data label 573288e0 #3. Player reports #11216 and #10994 (the mana cost of Mojo Beam and its branches) concern the per-tick drain of clause 42, not this 20% (see the author report).

behaviours.name: Mojo Beam (heals 277 every 0.5 sec)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:167-213 (Tick): one heal of effect 0 amount per branch every 500 ms (Completion.cpp:339-343 makes Effect[0] a 500 ms periodic dummy, AttributesEx5 loses SPELL_ATTR5_SPELL_HASTE_AFFECTS_PERIODIC), Heal (Brewing.cpp:129-165) calls SpellHealingBonusDone with the coefficient row 501117 0.1073 x spell power (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:34) and HealBySpell, which the harness records in spell_heal_total {spell 501117, target caster}. The reference caster has 0 spell power, so the amount is 276 + 1 = 277 (tooltip $m1+0+$SP*0.1073 reads [=277] with the reference stats, packet token list). No ally stands in the scenario: the only branch is the caster, who is the Beam target. Heal critical hits are random, so Reg's Test Aura 984954 (spell crit -1000, the Necromancer's no-crit precondition fixture) is set on the caster in both phases: a crit is a different amount, not a different period. The first tick lands 500 ms after the apply (no start-at-apply flag), so 3200 ms of cast-start game time hold ticks at 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500 and 3000: six heals, 6 x 277 = 1662 (five would read 1385, seven 1939). cast_power 2000 before the cast covers the opening 15% (about 224) and the drain of six ticks (about 1190, Brewing.cpp:191-196). Control: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0. This entry is the unhasted baseline of the haste entry (same scenario with Bloodlust set on the caster). Period bound (G-19, reviewer M-4): six heals by the 3200 ms read bound the period to (457, 533] ms (3200 / 7 and 3200 / 6). The excluded periods are 457 ms or less (seven or more heals) and above 533 ms (five or fewer); this interval is wider than the G-19 band of 5% of 500 ms (475 to 525 ms). The exact period is carried by the data label 501117 aura_amplitude_ms #1 (500 ms); this entry proves the heals really come at that cadence within those bounds.

behaviours.name: Mojo Beam (unaffected by haste: still six heals in 3200 ms)

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:167-213 (Tick): one heal of effect 0 amount per branch every 500 ms (Completion.cpp:339-343 makes Effect[0] a 500 ms periodic dummy, AttributesEx5 loses SPELL_ATTR5_SPELL_HASTE_AFFECTS_PERIODIC), Heal (Brewing.cpp:129-165) calls SpellHealingBonusDone with the coefficient row 501117 0.1073 x spell power (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:34) and HealBySpell, which the harness records in spell_heal_total {spell 501117, target caster}. The reference caster has 0 spell power, so the amount is 276 + 1 = 277 (tooltip $m1+0+$SP*0.1073 reads [=277] with the reference stats, packet token list). No ally stands in the scenario: the only branch is the caster, who is the Beam target. Heal critical hits are random, so Reg's Test Aura 984954 (spell crit -1000, the Necromancer's no-crit precondition fixture) is set on the caster in both phases: a crit is a different amount, not a different period. The first tick lands 500 ms after the apply (no start-at-apply flag), so 3200 ms of cast-start game time hold ticks at 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500 and 3000: six heals, 6 x 277 = 1662 (five would read 1385, seven 1939). cast_power 2000 before the cast covers the opening 15% (about 224) and the drain of six ticks (about 1190, Brewing.cpp:191-196). Control: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0. Bloodlust 2825 (Effect[0] aura 65 casting speed, base 19 + 1 = +20%; harness set_aura on the caster, a precondition fixture: the subject is the Beam's period, haste is only present, and a real cast of 2825 is a Shaman spell the class cannot cast) would leave 7 periods (3200 / 416) if the period followed the haste, so the same 1662 read as heal_ticks proves the period is not shortened. The control arm of this clause is heal_ticks (identical scenario without the haste aura, same reading); a hasted period would read 1939 and alert. Limits (reviewer M-3): nothing in this scenario reads that the Bloodlust fixture took effect, and the expected reading equals the unhasted one, so a fixture that failed would also pass; the entry shows the period is not shortened only when the fixture works, and heal_ticks is the identical run without it. The core flag removal (Completion.cpp:342) is a no-op for the DBC, since 501117 AttributesEx5 is 0 (the haste flag is absent from the start); the claim is therefore met by the DBC, and what the entry guards is a script or aura that shortens the period under haste. Tool note: a haste readback (spell_cast_time_ms of a hasted cast) in the same scenario, which metric_delta cannot take beside its one metric.

behaviours.name: Spirit Volley (the transform lasts 6 sec)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:30-36 and :82 (SyncReplacements): while Spirit Volley Ready 505158 is on the caster, the highest known Reclamation rank (id == KnownRank) gets SetTemporarySpellReplacement(rank, Volley 504582), the client-visible transform; SyncReplacements runs after every script cast (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:384) and every 500 ms (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:463). AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:315-317 casts 505158 on the caster with the 30% roll of the chance clause, which has its own claim; here the ready aura is made by a real cast of 505158 at the caster (the spell the roll would cast, not a harness set_aura), so the transform and its duration are read without the roll. Spirit Volley Ready 505158 has DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms ($505158d). It is on the caster 5700 ms after the cast and gone 6300 ms after it, so the end lies inside the G-19 band (5% of 6000 ms = 300 ms) on both sides, with the reads stamped in game time. Control: the uncast before phase reads absent.

behaviours.name: Spirit Volley (one Spirit Volley cast uses up the transform)
behaviours.quote: transform your next Reclamation into Spirit Volley
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:377 (OnSpellCast, a non-triggered cast): consume(VolleyReady, id == Volley) removes 505158 when the Volley cast completes, not when its projectile lands, so the next Reclamation is the only one transformed (report #7393: old CoA allowed a second Spirit Volley per proc while the first was in flight). The ready aura is made by a real cast of 505158 at the caster in both phases (setup cast, setup_in_before). Spirit Volley 504582: CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms, ranged slot (dummy at 15 yd, past the minimum range), no mana cost; the aura is read 1900 ms after the cast start, 100 ms after the cast ends, while the projectile is still flying toward a dummy 15 yd away (Spirit Volley 504582 has Speed 25, so the bolt lands about 600 ms after the cast end, and the 1900 ms read falls in flight). Control: the before phase makes the ready aura without casting the Volley and reads 1, so a second cast would be possible; the after phase reads 0 after one cast. Because the read falls while the bolt is in flight, the entry separates removal at the cast end (Abilities.cpp:377) from removal at the hit, which is the state report #7393 describes (a second Spirit Volley per proc while the first is flying): the reported failure would read 1 here. Cycle 6 (M-33, D2): Volley 504582 uses the ranged slot, so its 1800 ms cast is 2300 ms (SpellInfo.cpp:3108-3111); the read at 2550 ms falls after the cast ends (removal at cast completion, Abilities.cpp:377) and before the bolt lands (about 2870 ms).

behaviours.name: Spirit Volley (reduces the cooldown of Spirit Glaive by 3 sec)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:305-311 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered): id == Volley -> Reduce(player, Glaive, abs(Amount(VolleyCooldown))), ModifySpellCooldown(-3000) on every known rank of Spirit Glaive (Completion.cpp:161-174); 504584 Effect[0] BasePoints -3001 + 1 = -3000 ($/1000;504584s1 = 3). The ready aura 505158 is set by harness set_aura in both phases (precondition fixture, guide 3.4; the subject is the cooldown cut, the 30% roll that makes the aura has its own claim). A real setup cast of 505158, as the consumed entry makes, is not used for two reasons: setup_target is one value for every setup cast of an entry and the Glaive setup needs the dummy while 505158 needs the caster; and a real 505158 listed before the Glaive would sit through the Glaive's 2000 ms cast and the 2500 ms setup waits (about 7000 ms) and expire (6000 ms) before the Volley starts. Setup cast in both phases: a real Spirit Glaive 562719 at the dummy (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, CategoryRecoveryTime 20000, GCD 1500) and 2500 ms of wait. Before phase: that setup only, read at about 20000 - 2500 = 17500 ms remaining minus clock overhead (before_expected 12000 is only the floor that no clamp hides the cut). After phase: the setup repeated (Glaive cooldown reset and recast), then one real Volley (1800 ms cast, 15 yd dummy) and 2800 ms of wait: 2800 ms later than the before reading, so the reading falls by 2800 plus the 3000 cut = -5800 (without the cut -2800, 3000 away). tolerance 200 covers the step overheads of the simulated clock (10 to 17 ms of game time per cast and wait step). Control: the before phase casts no Volley. Spirit Glaive has RangeIndex 1 (0 yd) as a cone; a cast at a dummy 15 yd away is not rangechecked by the existing reset entry's pattern (dummy at 3 yd) and the first run confirms it. Quote (reviewer M-7): the clause this entry proves is 'Reduces the cooldown of Spirit Glaive by $/1000;504584s1 sec', which is not in the DBC description of 503712 (the clause text is streamed); behaviours.behaviour_entry requires the quote to be a substring of that DBC description (behaviours.py:131-134), so the quote is the transform sentence the description holds. The ledger claim labels tie this entry to its clause.

A readback of the modifier engine on the spell (data conformant), not a hit: the damage of a hit is not read. The tooltip's own +20% is the expected increase, tolerance 0.5 of a point. behaviours.name: Ingredient: Bloodthistle (Potion leech once every 0.5 sec)
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once every 0.5 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: Bloodthistle potion 802975 (server DBC set: aura 354, $s1 = 4 + 1 = 5%, DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms; spell_proc row ProcFlags 332116 incl. DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_NEG and DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS, AttributesMask 2 (triggered spells proc), Cooldown 500, rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:25) on the caster: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:68-69 Check (outgoing damage, not Derived) and :199-205 Proc, Copy(caster, owner, ThistleHeal 803287, damage x 5 / 100), a HEAL at TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (Completion.cpp:365-371). The cause is real: Brewer 92085 learned, Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 cast, then Potion Toss 801661 at the caster (PotionEffects casts 802975, Brewing.cpp:86-107); the 801702 CasterAuraSpell is set by required_aura_steps (precondition fixture). Potion Toss is cast again before windows 8 and 15 (cause_every 7: instant, StartRecoveryTime 1500, CategoryRecoveryTime 15000 reset by the harness, 18% mana), so every window reads 13500 ms or less after the latest potion, inside 15000 less 1000. Triggers: Spirit Eclipse rank 7 811117 (instant, StartRecoveryTime 1500, CategoryRecoveryTime 10000 reset before each cast, 12% mana: cast_wait_ms 1600, cast_power 2000) at dummy2 with 3 Spirits 561136 set by harness set_aura before every cast (precondition fixture for the trigger, Witch Doctor ADR 0001): duration 250 x Spirits, and each of the three lifecycle ticks (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:285-302) casts Spirit Eclipse 802717 at dummy2 (Speed 25, a missile: it lands floor(distance / 25 s) later, Spell.cpp:2468-2476) and the Spirit Eclipse Explosion splash 802712 (Speed 0, lands at the tick) at every other hostile within 10 yd of dummy2, here dummy at 3 yd. Per window the first splash S1 is the first trigger and the first output; the first Eclipse hit A1 lands one flight time later and the third splash S3 500 ms after S1. The caster is relocated -6.6 yd before window 1 and -0.18 yd before each later window (harness relocate, a positioning fixture: the dummies are stationary), so the distance to dummy2 runs 11.6 to 15.2 yd and the flight time (that distance less the caster's combat reach, never under the 5 yd floor of Spell.cpp:2474-2475, over 25 yd/s) sweeps about 404 to 548 ms for a 1.5 yd reach, 7.2 ms per window, so A1 sweeps across the gate. The probes are A1, the first event of its stream, and S3, the last of its stream: both are placed exactly, so no middle-hit placement enters the bound. Reads per window since the 811117 cast: for 802712 on dummy and 802717 on dummy2 the count, first event and shortest and longest interval (three hits each, so the first and last are exact and the middle one lies between two stamps), and for 803287 the count, first event and intervals. The event stamps (GameTime::Now) and the proc cooldown (GameTime::SteadyNow, SpellAuras.cpp:2172-2189, Unit.cpp:14301) read the same simulated point inside one world update (GameTime.cpp:125-136 and 206-212; TakeStep runs before World::Update, Main.cpp:614), so a trigger t ms after an output is answered exactly when t >= 500. On a regular 25 ms grid every offset after S1 is a multiple of 25 ms: S3 is answered at 500 ms and the windows whose flight is 451 to 475 ms (476 to 500 ms when the hit fires from the update before) refuse A1 at exactly 475 ms, so the bracket (475, 500] is deterministic. On irregular grids the close is statistical: the kind test asserts ok in 1000 seeds of the lanes step model (3 to 25 ms) per update order (0 failures bound the miss rate below 3/1000 per run, rule of three, so the flip risk per pair below 6/1000), and timing-only arithmetic over 10000 seeds per combat reach (0.389, 1.5, 2.0 yd) and update order of the lanes model and of a model holding a random 1 to 25 ms step for up to 80 updates placed the refused exact probe at 484 to 499 ms and the answered output at 500 to 509 ms in all 120000 runs (rule of three: below 3/120000 per run under those models). A miss reads unmeasured, never a false ok: the bounds are exact or conservative. ranged_hit_rating and spell_hit_rating 10000: the Eclipse hit is ranged and the splash is magic, and one missed hit among the 126 would leave a window unpaired (unmeasured). Control: one Eclipse before the potion, no 803287 heal. spell_power 2000 player fixture.

behaviours.observe_source: Player report #10643: the Bloodthistle buff falls off while Jungle Shrooms and Fish Oil stay. Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is an infinite aura (DurationIndex 21, forced by AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:384-388) whose only effect is a periodic trigger every 1500 ms (EffectAmplitude[0], no SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD) of the Cauldron buff 802771 (APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, aura 118 +8% healing taken, DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms). 802771 has PreventionType 1 (silence); the Fish Oil and Frog Bones fields 803269 and 803697 and the Jungle Shrooms pulse 802703 have 0. Spell.cpp:6240-6243 runs CheckCasterAuras(preventionOnly) for a triggered spell with a prevention type whose triggering aura is positive, and Spell.cpp:7157-7160 refuses it while the caster has UNIT_FLAG_SILENCED. So while the Witch Doctor is silenced the refresh fails and 802771 lapses within 2000 ms; the other Cauldron effects keep refreshing. The tooltip states no exception (G-1), so the expected reading is 1. Before phase (no Ingredient cast, the control for the read): 802771 absent (0); the Spell Lock of the striker lands there too. expire_ms 14000: that first silence ends 3000 ms after it lands and the second lands about 19800 ms after the first, more than 15000 ms after the first ended, so the diminishing return of DIMINISHING_SILENCE (Spell Lock Mechanic 9, DRTYPE_PLAYER: SpellMgr.cpp:287-288, Unit.cpp:13087-13096, Spell.cpp:3181-3188) has reset and the second silence lasts the full 3000 ms. After phase: Mixologist 561069 is learned from the start (capacity 2, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:31, as in the 92085 max_two entry), Ingredient: Fish Oil 801662 is cast for real (setup cast: instant, 5% mana, StartRecoveryTime 1500 in category 130 shared with Bloodthistle, CategoryRecoveryTime 500: setup_wait_ms 1600), then Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 for real (instant, 5% mana), its first refresh 1500 ms later, then a passive striker (react state 0, spell_hit_bonus 100) casts the stock silence Spell Lock 24259 at the caster 1700 ms after the cast (aura 27, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, DmgClass 0); the read comes 2600 ms into the silence, after the 802771 from the 1500 ms refresh has expired (3500 ms after the cast) and before the silence ends (4700 ms). Guards (after_auras_present), read on the caster right before the after reading: Spell Lock 24259 must be present (the silence landed and still holds), and the Fish Oil Cauldron buff 803269 must be present (the control arm: Fish Oil ticks about 1400 and 2900 ms after the Bloodthistle cast, the second inside the silence, so 803269 holds at the read only if a PreventionType 0 refresh survives the silence; without that refresh it would have lapsed about 3400 ms after the cast). A missing guard reads unmeasured. With both guards present, a silence-gated Bloodthistle refresh reads 0 (alert, the candidate defect lead #10643 describes) and 1 means the buff survives a silence. Evidence class: the read is aura presence, a readback for this healing claim (G-21 amendment point 1), so evidence_metric aura_amount (a coverage.METRIC_EVIDENCE readback) stamps it: an ok adds a data label and cannot lift the Cauldron claim to status 1; only an applied heal could.

behaviours.name: Spirit Eclipse (one hit for each active Spirit)
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:143-149 (OnCalcMaxDuration: the Eclipse aura lasts 250 ms x the Spirits the caster has), AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:227-229 (on apply the aura stores _spirits = Spirits(player), the stack count of 561136) and :287-296 (Tick: one 802717 hit per tick while _ticks < _spirits, then Remove()). Spirit Eclipse 811117 (rank 7): instant, CategoryRecoveryTime 10000 reset by the scenario, GCD 1500, 12% mana, CasterAuraSpell 561136 (Spirit, StackAmount 5; one stack set by the harness before every cast), Effect[0] aura 227 every 250 ms ($t1). The treatment phase makes Spirits with a real Mirage 501136 (instant, 29% mana, RecoveryTime 180000 reset, GCD 1500; AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:345-346 GainSpirit(player, 5): the one fixture stack plus five, capped at 5), so the Eclipse cast 1700 ms later strikes five times. The control phase makes none (setup_only_after) and keeps the single fixture Spirit, one hit. The caster's 802717 damage events on the dummy are counted cumulatively: 1 after the first phase and 1 + 5 = 6 after the second. Repair (cycle 7, author C): in both final04 runs the Eclipse after Mirage failed with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS (reason 12, cast 3; the cast record shows target_visible false and target_check 12). Mirage's Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY type 0, and its tooltip says 'While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible'. WorldObject::CanDetectInvisibilityOf (Object.cpp:2034-2041) refuses an invisible seer a target that does not detect its invisibility, and the Mirage sight entry of this class already proves this. The server was right and the test was wrong. Before each Eclipse cast, in both phases, the dummy casts Detect Invisibility 132 on itself for real (target_casts_before, with the 300 ms settle; Effect[0] aura 19 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY_DETECT, MiscValue 0, amount 1000, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, DurationIndex 6). The harness casts a creature's spell with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:7639), so the dummy needs no mana and no GCD, and the cast is the same kind of real self-cast that the Witch Hunter witchblood_seen entry uses for its stealth. It is a precondition of the target, not the subject of the claim. HandleModInvisibilityDetect (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1827-1839) adds the general flag, so the objMask check at Object.cpp:2036-2040 passes and the invisible caster may target the dummy, as the tooltip allows for 'those who can see invisible'. Guide 3.4: the real cast costs about the same as a set_aura (one 300 ms settle per phase), so the cast is used. Mirage stays the real Spirit source: the only other real source the scenario can drive is four extra Spirit-generating casts (Family(info, 1, 4), AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:305-307), and the required-aura fixture of 811117 resets a set_aura of five Spirits to one before the cast (values.py:268-271). The detection cast is the same in both phases, so the control still differs only by the Mirage cast. Spirit Eclipse's 802717 hits are triggered, so they do not end Mirage (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:277-278). Tool note: the damage amount and the 250 ms period have no behaviour route (hit_mean is unmodelled for 811117; hit_period needs two Spirits, and its fixture sets one).

behaviours.name: Sentry Ward (a stealthed enemy 3 yd away becomes detectable)
behaviours.quote: reveals all stealthed and invisible enemies near it
behaviours.observe_source: Sentry Ward 674303 (#12534, "doesnt work at all"): instant, GCD 1000, ManaCost 25 plus ManaCostPercentage 15, DurationIndex 3 = 60000 ms, summon creature 51104 at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT (SQL rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:166-167 binds the summon script). AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:521-528: every second the ward takes Nearby(me, 30 yd) and, for each unit the owner is hostile to and the ward has in line of sight, player->AddAura(SentryReveal 505173, enemy) with duration 2200 ms, then removes the enemy's SPELL_AURA_MOD_STEALTH and SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY auras. Completion.cpp:546-551 rewrites 505173 to one SPELL_AURA_MOD_STALKED effect (aura 68), and Unit::IsAlwaysDetectableFor (Unit.cpp:12410-12416) makes a unit carrying it always detectable by the aura caster, ahead of every stealth check in WorldObject::CanDetect (Object.cpp:1975). Stealth Dummy 2144558 (aura 16, stealth 1000000) hides the dummy 3 yd away. The harness sets it on the dummy at the start of both phases. It is a precondition fixture: the subject of the claim is the ward, and the hiding aura is only the state to reveal, as in the Templar Crusader's Brand detection entry. can_detect is Unit::CanSeeOrDetect of the caster for the dummy with its default arguments. Repair (cycle 7, author C): in both final04 runs the control read 1 without a ward. The old entry read the before value right after the stealth set_aura, with no wait (gate_timing start, trigger_only_after: no cast in the control phase). With distanceCheck false, WorldObject::CanDetect (Object.cpp:1984-1992) passes checkClient and returns true for a stealthed unit the player still has at its client (Player::HaveAtClient), and the dummy had not yet left the caster's client set. The invisible variant reads 0 at once because the invisibility check has no such fallback (Object.cpp:1980-1983). The Templar predicate entry reads its hidden arm 1500 ms after the stealth aura and reads 0 (ADR 0197). The server was right and the test was wrong. Now both phases wait 2500 ms before the read. Berserking 26297 is the timed cast of both phases: a stock spell, instant, no cost (PowerType 3 with cost 0), StartRecoveryTime 0 so no GCD, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, Effect[0] aura 193 haste only. It is a vehicle that touches no stealth, invisibility or detection state. The ward is a real setup cast in the after phase only (setup_only_after). The harness fills every power of the caster at setup (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3038-3039) and nothing in the scenario spends mana before the ward, so its 25 mana plus 15% of base mana is there and no cast_power is needed. Control: stealth set, Berserking, 2500 ms, read 0 (the dummy has left the client set, and no ward exists). Treatment: stealth set, a real Sentry Ward cast, Berserking, 2500 ms, read 1 (the ward's first reveal ticks at about 1000 ms). If the ward revealed nothing, the treatment would read 0 as the control does. can_detect is a STATE metric (coverage.py:442). The only setup cast is the claim's own spell 674303 with setup_only_after, so the contrast is own_cast (behaviours.py:1673-1678), and the quote holds 'stealthed', so the entry counts as behaviour. The reveal_aura entry carries the event read of the same cast.

behaviours.name: Potent Mixes (threat generated -30%, second equal hit with the talent)
behaviours.quote: reduces the threat generated by your spells by
behaviours.observe_source: Potent Mixes 504888 Effect[1] in the DBC is SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_THREAT 103, EffectBasePoints -31 + DieSides 1 = -30 ($s2). Since fix 27bbb789d3, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp ApplyContracts (PotentMixes 503748 and PotentMixesGreater 504888) turns it into SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT with MiscValue 127 (all schools) at load, so ThreatManager::CalculateModifiedThreat multiplies every later threat of the caster by (100 - 30) / 100 = 0.7. Repair (cycle 7, author C): on the fixed build (verify-all 20261117-074923, server 41db1896c0e8) the old absolute entries read 0.828 with the talent and 1.168 without. Their with/without ratio is 0.709, which is the tooltip's 0.7. On the pair final04 (build c5caeee8740e, which predates 27bbb789d3) the talent arm read 1.1515 and 1.1519 against 1.1304 and 1.1325 for the control: a confirmed defect (recorded by D1, fixed by 27bbb789d3), on top of the absolute-target flaw. Both entries missed their absolute targets because of a threat excess with no matching health loss (D1.md: about 0.13 to 0.17 of the damage). Its source is the initial threat that Spell::HandleThreatSpells adds: m_spellInfo->SpellLevel when the spell has no spell_threat entry (Spell.cpp:5736-5737), 60 for Shadow Bolt 25307, added after PoolThreatFor with ignoreModifiers true (Spell.cpp:5765-5766). 45648 has SpellLevel 0, so that threat is 0 and HandleThreatSpells returns early (Spell.cpp:5740-5741): no excess remains. The hit is QA Debug Holy Spell 45648: Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE 999 + DieSides 1 = 1000 fixed, SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, StartRecoveryTime 0 (no GCD), no power cost (no mana is spent, so no energize threat follows), damage threat added unscaled as float(damage) at Unit.cpp:1412, and spell hit capped by the reference spell_hit_rating 10000. Before (talent unlearned, the control): global cooldown 1500 ms, about 560 ms left at the attempt (more than the 400 ms queue window), refused, 67. After (300660 learned between the phases, 2500 ms apart): global cooldown 1000 ms, already over or within the queue window at the attempt, accepted, 0. Cast timing checked: Frog Bones, Hexbreak and Potion Toss are instant (CastingTimeIndex 1). behaviours.observe_source: Malignant Jinx 803678: instant (CastingTimeIndex 1), RecoveryTime 60000 (reset by the scenario), GCD 1500, 19% mana plus 10, RangeIndex 4, Dispel 2 (curse), DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms. Effect[0] is turned into a dummy aura (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:453-454). AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:282-299 (OnSpellCast, every unit, only for a non-triggered cast): every Malignant Jinx 803678 on the caster is removed and its doctor casts Jinx silence 803732 (Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE 27, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, TargetA TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, PreventionType 1) with Cast(doctor, caster, JinxSilence), Completion.cpp:83-87 = doctor->CastSpell(caster, 803732, true). 803732 binds aura_ascension_witch_doctor_lifecycle (SQL rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:276-277). The Jinxed unit is an enemy player of race 2 (enemy_player_race, pvp flags on) because the harness casts for creatures are triggered (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:7634) and the hook skips triggered casts; the enemy casts a real Renew 25222 at itself (a real cast packet, learned by the scenario) 500 ms after the doctor's Jinx. Both phases run the enemy casts; before phase (the control, cast_in_before false, enemy_casts_in_before): no Jinx cast, the enemy casts Renew freely. Candidate defect lead L1: 803732 names TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, which Spell::SelectImplicitCasterTargets resolves to the caster of the spell, the doctor, not to the unit passed to CastSpell, so the silence is predicted to land on the Witch Doctor and not on the Jinxed enemy (the read on the enemy would be 0, the read on the doctor 1); reported, not fixed here. This entry reads 803732 on the doctor 500 ms after the enemy's Renew: the tooltip silences them, not the caster, so the expected reading is 0 (before phase 0 as well); a 1 is the predicted defect. Clause 338. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell. Cast timing checked: Jinx instant with a 1500 ms global cooldown (the enemy's Renew comes 500 ms after it, wait_ms 500), Renew 25222 instant.

behaviours.name: Shadowhunter (mana cost of all spells and abilities -25%)
behaviours.quote: In addition, reduces the mana cost of all spells and abilities by $680880s3%.
behaviours.observe_source: Shadowhunter 92086 (passive): AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:218-219 (lifecycle apply) and :471-472 (update) cast Shadowhunter cost 680880 on the doctor while 92086 is known (removed at :401-402 and :473-474 otherwise); 680880 Effect[2] SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT, misc 127, -26 + 1 = -25 ($680880s3), which SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost (SpellInfo.cpp:3194-3277) multiplies into every cost as int32(cost x (1.0f + multiplier)). The mana a real cast spends is the claim: Cursed Effigy 706542 (instant, no global cooldown, 16% of the base mana, RecoveryTime 60000 reset by the scenario) is cast for real at the caster with the power set to 2000 and regeneration off. Exact costs: the reference base mana is about 1497 (434 = 29% for Mirage in the final03 power readback bounds it to 1496.6 up to 1499.9), so int32(base x 16 / 100.0f) = 239 for every base in that range; with the passive int32(239 x 0.75f) = int32(179.25) = 179. The power left reads 2000 - 239 = 1761 without 92086 (before phase, the control) and 2000 - 179 = 1821 with it (learned between the phases, 1000 ms apart), a gain of exactly 60: a deterministic reading judged to the rounding (G-19, tolerance 0.5), so a 24% reduction (gain 57), a 26% one (gain 63) or none (0) all fall outside. before_expected 1700 is the least before reading at which no floor of the metric hides the gain. behaviours.name: Serene Idol (pushback reduction 30%, game time)
behaviours.quote: reduced spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks
behaviours.observe_source: Serene Idol 504759: the idol applies field 504760 to the caster (and grouped allies within 30 yd) every second (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:515-520); 504760 Effect[2] SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK, BasePoints 29 + 1 = 30 ($504760s3). Stock pushback (Spell::Delayed, Spell.cpp:8066-8090) delays the cast by 500 ms per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. One scenario, three Malefic Wrath 807037 casts (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, 11% mana, cast_power 2000 before each) at the dummy: unhit; hit once by the passive striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 (Holy) 1000 ms into the cast; and the same after a real cast of Serene Idol 504759 (instant, reducer_wait_ms 1600 past its GCD of 1000 ms, so the field has landed: the idol's first update is at once). The windows are the Necromancer Icebound Champion windows moved to a 2000 ms cast: the Icebound unhit window [2440, 2480] sits 40 ms before its 2500 ms nominal end, the hit window 490 ms later and the 50% reduced window 240 ms after the unhit one, so for 2000 ms the unhit window is [1940, 1980], the hit window [2430, 2470] and the 30% reduced window (350 ms instead of 500, 340 ms after the unhit centre) [2280, 2320]. The judge brackets the reduction from the polled cast ends, not from the windows; the windows only choose which polls are read, so a wrong window gives unmeasured, never ok. repeats 4 as the Icebound entry. Control: the unhit and hit casts without the idol. behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:309-310 (the Cleansing Idol 50217 sets _timer 3000 when it is summoned) and :509-513 (each 3000 ms it casts Cleansing Idol 505348 on every ally Allies(player, me, 30 yd) returns, the caster included); Completion.cpp:507-515 retargets 505348 to TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY. 505348 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL EffectMiscValue 3 (DISPEL_DISEASE) and Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL EffectMiscValue 4 (DISPEL_POISON), EffectBasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = one effect per type per pulse. Fixtures: Frost Fever 55095 and Blood Plague 55078, both Dispel 3, DurationIndex 8 or 29 (15000 or 12000 ms), so neither expires inside the 6600 ms window. The removal order of two fixtures of one type is not fixed, so each reading sums them (periodic_dispel sum_labels). Control: both fixtures stay 6300 ms without the spell. With a real Cleansing Idol cast at the caster: both present 300 ms before the first pulse (2700 ms), one fewer 300 ms after it (3300 ms) and none after the second pulse (6300 ms). The arm proves one disease per pulse; the poison half of "1 poison and disease effect" has no entry of its own because periodic_dispel labels carry no variant suffix, so a second arm would collide with this one (tool note T-pd), and a mixed set would remove one of each, which the kind's one-removal-per-period model cannot express. Cleansing Idol 504840 costs 25% of the base mana, available at the full pool of the base steps. AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:356-357 (OnSpellCast) casts Da Tiki Waters 500747 on the caster for a Tiki Splash cast with Base: Crystal Water active (Beast Blood casts Da Tiki Beast 500598 instead).
