behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (a ranged critical strike rating makes three of three ranged hits ready the glaive)
behaviours.quote: Chance increased by your ranged critical strike rating.
behaviours.observe_source: Umbral Glaive 681242 (passive, spell_proc ProcFlags 320, Chance 100 since rev_20261003_10, so the script rolls once): AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:91-96 (Check) rolls roll_chance_f(ProcChance 10 + player->GetRatingBonusValue(CR_CRIT_RANGED)) on a ranged damage hit that is not Umbral Glaive itself, and :157-159 (Proc) casts the ready buff 504588 on the caster. The clause is that the chance grows with the ranged critical strike rating. This entry is the arm with a rating: force_crit ranged (ADR 0692) sets the scenario character's ranged_crit_rating to FORCED_CRIT_RATING 100000 (a precondition fixture named in the verdict, written by metric_delta itself; it is not a class ratings key), which makes the roll far above 100% on every landed ranged hit. Three real Reclamation 806288 casts (ranged slot, 1800 ms cast, 8% mana) land on the dummy 15 yd away in each phase: two setup casts 2300 ms apart (past the 1800 ms cast and the 1500 ms global cooldown, the cooldown reset before each by the scenario) and the trigger cast; the casts of the ready buff 504588 by the caster (spell_cast_count, one per proc) are read 2800 ms after the third cast. Before phase (the control: the same three casts and the same rating without the passive 681242 learned): 0. After phase (681242 learned): 3, one proc per hit. The arm with no rating is the unforced 10% entry (the procs entry of 681242, rating 0 on the reference character, the band 8 to 12%): the rate is read at 10% there and at 100% here, so the clause "Chance increased by your ranged critical strike rating" has both arms. A server that ignored the rating would read 3 of 3 with probability 0.1 x 0.1 x 0.1 = 0.001 per run (1e-6 per pair), below D-197; a server that procs every hit regardless of rating is rejected by the 10% arm. Mana: three casts at 8% of the base mana are inside the 1000 power set before the first. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md. Cast timing checked: Reclamation 1800 ms (CastingTimeIndex 23), Speed 35 (the hit about 430 ms later), setup waits 2300 ms.

behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (the curse leeches every 1 sec: four ticks by 4916 ms, the fifth by 5416 ms)
behaviours.observe_source: Umbral Glaive 501134 (instant, 9% mana, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms, Speed 30, SchoolMask Shadow, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_LEECH EffectAmplitude 1000 ($t1)): AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:467-471 zeroes Effect[1], gives the spell the Hex of Malice family flag and clears SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, so the first tick is 1000 ms after the apply and the DoT does not start at once (player report #1506 lists "DoT starting at once" among the failures of Umbral Glaive; clause 136 states the period). Its cast needs the ready buff 504588 (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:76), set on the caster by setup_actor_aura (a named precondition fixture: the subject is the curse, the buff is the product of the proc read by `ready`). The beeg spellpen aura 823764 on the caster (a named precondition fixture, the Hex tick entry precedent) keeps a partial resist from removing a tick. Each leech tick heals the caster (Unit::HealBySpell, a heal log of 501134 on the caster, counted by spell_heal_count). The glaive lands about 166 ms after the cast (Speed 30, the dummy 3 yd away, floored to 5 yd: floor(5 / 30 x 1000) = 166, Spell.cpp:2474-2476) and ticks at 1166, 2166, 3166, 4166 and 5166 ms: the heals of 501134 on the caster are counted twice, stamped in game time, 4 at 4916 ms after the cast (window 4866 to 4966 ms, wait 4907 ms plus the 9 ms of the stamp step) and 5 at 5416 ms (window 5366 to 5466 ms). The two stamps are the fifth tick's time at a period 5% short (166 + 5 x 950 = 4916 ms) and at a period 5% long (166 + 5 x 1050 = 5416 ms): a period of 950 ms or less would have brought the fifth tick by the first stamp and reads 5 there, a period of 1050 ms or more brings it no earlier than the second stamp and reads 4 there, and a first tick at the apply (the reported "DoT starting at once") reads 5 at the first stamp. The accepted periods are 950 to 1050 ms, centred on the clause's 1 sec once the flight time is in the stamps. Judged as a bracket in game time (the G-19 band of 5% of the period): the count read at the first stamp must still be short of the pulse that a period 5% too short would have brought, the count read at the second stamp must include the pulse that a period 5% too long would still be missing; a count of whole heals read at one time accepts about +-20% of the period, which the two stamps avoid. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0. The duration half of the clause is read by scales_lasts_control (the curse still stands at 5900 ms and is gone 400 ms later, its end at about 6166 ms). Player reports: #1506 (Umbral Glaive), see above. Cast timing checked: instant.

behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (one leech tick heals about 21 health, the Description's ${$m1+0+$RAP*0.1})
behaviours.observe_source: Umbral Glaive 501134 (instant, 9% mana, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms, Speed 30, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_LEECH EffectAmplitude 1000, EffectBasePoints 2 + 1 = 3 ($m1), 0.3 per level, SpellLevel 14): the clause is the Description "leeching ${$m1+0+$RAP*0.1} health"; the Description governs, read literally (G-1), and a buff tooltip never overrides the spell's own text (G-7), so the ToolTip's "${$m1+$ppl1+$RAP*0.26}" of the same spell is not the claim. The engine value is the data label's: 3 + 13 (46 levels x 0.3 = 13.8 truncated before the sum, SpellInfo.cpp:497) + RAP 47 x 0.1 (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:36, ModifySpellEffectBaseValue, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:640-655, BonusMultiplier 0 so no second bonus, :580-582) = 20.7, read 20 after the int32 truncation (the data verdict reads measured 20 against 20.7); the leech heals the caster for the damage dealt (EffectValueMultiplier 1.0, Unit::HealBySpell). One real Umbral Glaive at the dummy (the ready buff 504588 set on the caster by setup_actor_aura, a named precondition fixture: the subject is the leech, the buff is the product of the proc read by `ready`; the beeg spellpen aura 823764 on the caster, a named precondition fixture that keeps a partial resist from lowering the tick); the glaive lands about 166 ms after the cast (Speed 30, the dummy 3 yd away, floored to 5 yd, Spell.cpp:2474-2476) and the first tick is 1000 ms later (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:467-471 clears the initial period), at about 1166 ms; the heals of 501134 on the caster are summed 1600 ms after the cast, which holds the first tick only (the second is at about 2166 ms). The caster is set to 5000 of 10000 health so the heal is effective. No periodic crit aura stands (the passive 574358 is not learned, see periodic_crit), no die: the tick is the same amount every time, 20.7 within 1 (5%, G-19 scope, ADR 0135). A ToolTip-sized read (3 + 13.8 + RAP x 0.26 = 29) lies far outside the band and would be the candidate defect lead L-u1; a missing per-level term reads 7.7. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0. Player reports: #1506 (Umbral Glaive) names failures of the buff and the macro cast, not the amount. Cast timing checked: instant.

Hex of Malice 504608 (rank 8, instant, 20% mana, DurationIndex 106 = 24000 ms, cast_power 2000) is a real setup cast at the dummy, and the scenario waits 6000 ms, so the Hex aura has decayed to about 18000 ms; then the Umbral Glaive is cast (it needs the ready buff 504588, set by setup_actor_aura, a named precondition fixture: the subject is the refresh, the buff is the product of the proc read by `ready`; it stands 10000 ms, so it is still on at the Umbral cast 6000 ms after the Hex) and the remaining duration of 504608 (caster the Witch Doctor) on the dummy is read 500 ms after the Umbral cast, about 330 ms after the glaive landed (about 166 ms of flight). behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:98-99 (Check, case Overflow): damage and the spell is Shadow Puppet 802745 (PuppetHit, the hit each Shadow Puppets 500015 tick casts, Auras.cpp:279-283) or Puppeteer's Threads damage 572837 (ThreadsDamage); :73 lets a derived spell through for Overflow; :164-167 (Proc): Reduce(player, BadJuju, INT32_MAX) (Completion.cpp:161-174: RemoveSpellCooldown of every known rank with update) and Cast(OverflowBuff 705845). 705844 is a passive with ProcFlags 0 and ProcChance 15 ($h) and a spell_proc row (ProcFlags 332116, AttributesMask 2, Chance 0 after rev_20260919_20, so the DBC 15 applies); the aura script aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event (rev_20260909_00 :183) filters in DoCheckProc. 705845 (DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms) Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN of Bad Juju 802087 (MiscValueB 1: its category too) and Effect[1] aura 107 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN -10000 on Bad Juju (mask word 1 1024), consumed by the next Juju cast (Abilities.cpp:376, consume(OverflowBuff, IsJuju)). Shadow Puppets 500015: instant, GCD 1500, 15% base mana, RecoveryTime 18000 reset before each cast, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, EffectAmplitude 750 with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, so 5 PuppetHit events per cast. Each phase first casts a real Bad Juju 802087 at the dummy (setup, 2500 ms cast, 15000 ms category cooldown), so a cooldown runs, then Shadow Puppets 500015 with the forced roll of proc_buff. The reset reaches the client as SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN (0x1DE = 478) whose first field is 802087, counted by server_packets with row 802087 (the 705948 reset_packet shape). The count is cumulative: every harness reset_cooldown of 802087 sends the same packet, one per phase before the Juju setup cast, so the before phase reads exactly 1 and the after phase reads 1 + 1 fixture clear + the packets of the proc: Reduce sends one (Completion.cpp:161-174), the buff's Effect[0] and its category reset send more (SpellEffects.cpp:1103-1112, 360-368), so the after floor is 3. Without the talent nothing resets it (2 in the after phase would show a missing proc). Player reports: none. Cast timing checked: Bad Juju 2500 ms cast then 2800 ms wait, Puppets instant.

behaviours.name: Hastened (Shadow Effigy cooldown 25% shorter)
behaviours.observe_source: Hastened 705899 (passive, Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25 = $s1, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 8320 = 8192 | 128): a native modifier, no script (class map risk stock): Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to the recovery of a spell of the mask. Shadow Effigy 505339 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 8192, RecoveryTime 12000, summon of 50119, 15% base mana, instant, GCD 1000) and Swift Idol 804226 (8192 | 64, RecoveryTime 60000, 20% base mana, instant) carry the mask: their cooldowns with the talent are 25% shorter. Stasis Ward 801678 (RecoveryTime 60000) carries the mask too and has its own entry (ward). Arms, each timed from a priming Shadow Effigy cast: an attempt 9500 ms later without the talent (refused, SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, 2500 ms left), 9500 ms later with it (goes through: 12000 x 0.75 = 9000 ms) and 8500 ms later with it (refused, the cut is not larger than 25%). A recast consumes the cooldown, which a cooldown_ms read does not show. cast_power 2000 covers the 15% mana of the priming cast and the attempts. Cast timing checked: instant, 1000 ms GCD. Limit, stated in the verdict: the cooldown-bearing shapes tested are the Shadow Effigy (effigy entry), the Stasis Ward (ward entry) and the Swift Idol (idol entry); the spells of the mask without a recovery time (Serpent Ward 500960, Dark Idol 507082) show no cut, and the remaining ones with a recovery time are named untested in the clause 196 reason (G-23).
